exact_statement: Let g_n on the uniform n-cube be negative exactly on binary indices {0,1,2}, p_n=3*2^-n, and F_n=J(g_n^6) with disjoint physical cores, h negative on{0,1,2,4,8,16,32,6,17,40}, J(x)=-h(x xor1). Reveal only block0 until its core is constant, retaining all five other cores. With q0 its outer pivot and S4=4I-H, the signed cumulative full rate4 excess e_n equals C(p,...,p)-(1-p)C(0,p,...,p)-p C(1,p,...,p)-q0*S4(g_n), independent of the physical determining query order. Then e_n/p_n^2 tends to128/3-24log2(3)+32log2(e)>50.79; hence every sufficiently large n defeats a nonnegative fully transported selected-core-only rate4 account. The actual negative selected endpoint T_n=J(-1,g_n^5) has S4(T_n)/p_n^2 tending to96log2(3)-320/3-32log2(e)<-0.6765, so branchwise rate4 other-owner endpoint eligibility also fails for every sufficiently large n. No explicit tail cutoff is asserted. Exact separate certificates prove e_n>0, S4(F_n)>0 and S4(T_n)<0 for n in{6,7,8,9,10,11,12,16,24,32,48,64}; the fixed n6 order[2,0,1,3,4,5] first reaches negative full S4 at depth6 and preserves the source two-query no-renewal identity. Both H(F_n)/I(F_n) and H(T_n)/I(T_n) tend to4. No unbounded FEI family, impossibility for larger fixed K, or refutation of a scoped source first/two-query theorem is claimed.

exact_statement: Let h be the six-bit Boolean sign negative exactly on binary indices {0,1,2,4,8,16,32,6,17,40}, with one bits denoting negative inputs, and J(x)=-h(x xor1). For every nonconstant Boolean core g on every finite uniform cube, oriented to P(g=-1)=p with 0<p<=1/16, form F=k(g_1,...,g_6) from six identical disjoint copies, k in {h,J}. For any actual physical coordinate i in block j, retain C(p_vec)=H_(p_vec)(k)-sum_l q_l h2(4p_l(1-p_l)), where q_l are the full heterogeneous outer pivotal probabilities, and define Delta C=C_parent-(C_child+ +C_child-)/2 using the true uniform query weights. Then Delta C<=(5/4)Inf_(j,i)(F), with sharper coefficients1/2 for h,1/8 for J directions1,2,3,5, and3/4 for J direction0. Direction4 uses5/4. Writing d=Inf_i(g), beta=ghat({i}), q=q_j, the stronger bias-dependent inequality is Delta C<=q beta^2 log2(1+16(1-q)/(9q)); the full exact decrement is Delta H(F)=q Delta H(g)+Delta C. For the selected mean x and fixed other five output laws, the non-affine terminal correction has C_j second derivative -2 sum_T d_T^2 log2((a_T+x d_T)^2/(x^2 d_T^2)), and its central second difference is the exact nonnegative tent-kernel integral of that logarithmic density. The bound covers every real attainable bias and singleton shift, beta=0, irrelevant coordinates, a constant child and integrable coefficient-zero singularities. It is a signed upper bound at the first query with identical starting biases, not an absolute-value price, an inherited-core payment, a hereditary heterogeneous-history bound or a universal FEI theorem.
